name: ds-harness-remote
description: 基于 DeepSeek Harness 插件机制构建的远程访问方案，通过低延迟、端到端加密的 P2P 网络，支持使用 PC、移动端 和 Web 随时访问本地设备上的DSH 、CodeX、Cursor、Claude Code等工作区。 (Built on DeepSeek Harness plugins, this low-latency, end-to-end encrypted P2P solution lets PC, mobile, and web clients access local DSH, Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code workspaces.)

capability_evidence.auto-failover: public IP is required on the Harness Host.
capability_evidence.remote-control: - Support DeepSeek Harness Desktop, ready to use after installation. - Run a terminal-only dsh-TUI profile as a Host. - No public listening port or public IP is required on the Harness Host.
capability_evidence.gui-desktop: ported Install ds-harness-remote@0.5.19; this computer can also be the Host

friction.note_en: Easy. install via native installer / package; configure OAuth login flow, sign-in required
friction.note_zh: 较易上手。可通过 native installer / package 安装；需配置 OAuth login flow、sign-in required

analysis.summary_en: Remote mode supports the official plugin page for listing, configuration, and enabling/disabling plugins (requires an updated Host Remote plugin).
highlights: The current development baseline is dsh-v0.2.1-rc.1; validation scope is documented in the compatibility guide.
Run a terminal-only dsh-TUI profile as a Host.
Android keeps per-conversation drafts and reading positions, offers backend-separated search
Access your local Harness instance remotely from the web, a PC, or a mobile device: DSH first, with Codex, Cursor, and Antigravity support too.
analysis.summary_zh_native: 远程模式支持官方插件页的列表、配置和启用/停用（需更新 Host Remote 插件）。Remote 自身仍只能在 Host 本地配置和启停；不开放远程安装、卸载。
highlights_zh: 当前开发适配基线为 dsh-v0.2.1-rc.1，验证范围见兼容性说明。
Harness 主机无需开放公网监听端口，无需公网IP，可以从任意可上网的地方，通过双向端到端加密链路安全连接。
从另一台设备（Web、PC、移动端）远程到本地Harness实例：DSH 优先，CodeX、Cursor、Antigravity 一样可用。
支持新建工作区、模型配置、对话模型切换，远端如本地一样丝滑。
